# Gameplay clip sources

Short muted gameplay excerpts are served locally with the website. Each source is linked below the active clip in the demo. Recordings and game content belong to their respective owners.

- **World of Warcraft**: Gameplay captured by godradar on Medal.tv; World of Warcraft by Blizzard Entertainment. [Source recording](https://medal.tv/games/world-of-warcraft/clips/nQ3u6NXSsOa64WWIt). Local clip: `world-of-warcraft.mp4`, 8 seconds, excerpt beginning at 0.5 seconds. Public creator gameplay preview, not official Blizzard promotional footage.
- **Euro Truck Simulator 2**: SCS Software. [Source recording](https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/). Local clip: `euro-truck-simulator-2.mp4`, 12 seconds, excerpt beginning at 16 seconds.
- **No Man's Sky**: Hello Games. [Source recording](https://store.steampowered.com/app/275850/No_Mans_Sky/). Local clip: `no-mans-sky.mp4`, 8.5 seconds, excerpt beginning at 30 seconds.

The mini player is an illustration over gameplay footage. These are website demonstrations, not recordings of DMC Player running over the games.
